description: Jest 30.5.2's v8 coverage provider on the same rebuilt sample as `babel-providers-sample` (T8.12, B23b): five modules under src/ (edge.ts with a `return -1` after a call that always throws, default parameters and `istanbul ignore` hints, which the v8 provider does not read; untested.ts, which no test imports and Jest reports from its `(empty-report)` range; pricing.ts, cart.ts and format.ts) and 17 tests in tests/. `coverageProvider: 'v8'`, `collectCoverageFrom: ['src/**/*.ts']`. Jest runs the TypeScript as its documentation sets it up, babel-jest with `@babel/preset-typescript` (`jestTypeScript`, D123). The `json`, `json-summary` and `text` reports are recorded as Jest wrote them (the work directory as `<root>`), and so is `--json`'s `coverageMap`. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-v8.test.ts` and the policy claims for `coverage.v8Conversion` and `coverage.v8HitCounts`.
